body: Worker trap (Termal::Opus3, 2026-11-13, e105 evaluation 3): termal_evaluate_acceptance refuses with committed_input_no_eligible_run unless the claim's named root HEAD is the commit of an eligible passing registered run. I had moved the root to the new master for a FULL that was later dequeued, and the request was refused. The fix is to check the root out back at the checked commit, clean, before requesting. Also: non-holder notes (a coordinator's concurrence) are refused as criterionEvidence; quote them verbatim in a holder note and cite that.
